proposals.evidence: Turner lists Punjabi bahārī/buhārī and Lahnda bohārī broom, with Prakrit baühārī/bōhārī and Gujarati bārvũ sweep. The contracted bāh-/bhā-rī survey forms fit this northwestern and western broom family. This is a qualified comparative placement allowing contraction and aspiration displacement; obscure retroflex-expanded and tonal p-initial forms are excluded, as is the explicitly uncertain Gawri comparison under vardhana.
